summary: Iteration 3 — full functional audit for Class Up · El Castillo. Added /app/backend/tests/test_iteration_3_audit.py (22 new tests) covering: /auth/me demo profile (Juan David Martínez, section=A, jornada=Tarde, guardian María Martínez/3000000000, both onboarding flags true); MongoDB counts (26 tasks, 25 grades, 23 events, 98 resources) — all match spec; no `_id` leaks on any GET (auth/me, tasks, grades, grades/summary, events, resources, progress, assessments, sessions, sessions/summary); Tasks CRUD lifecycle with due_date=today + ~2h and propagation to /progress (tasks_total/completed/pending); Grades create → summary recomputes with per-subject count → delete restores overall exactly; Events count = 23, create → 24, wrong-owner delete = 404, delete → 23; Resources filter (Todos = 98, Matemáticas = 21, Sociales = 19, legacy 'Sociales y Ciudadanas' = 0 — rename fully complete); PATCH /api/profile uppercases section 'b'→'B', preserves profile_setup_completed & initial_assessment_completed, rejects empty body with 'Sin cambios' and empty required field with 400 (section restored to 'A' in teardown); fresh audit user (user_fresh_audit / TOKEN_FRESH_AUDIT) walks the mandatory-onboarding gates (a→d), then is fully deleted; POST /api/import/bulk empty → zero counts, 1-of-each persists in Mongo & does NOT touch profile flags (test rows are cleaned up); cross-user isolation — fresh user cannot see any of user_test123's tasks/grades/events. Also fixed pre-existing test suites to reflect the renamed subject 'Sociales' (was 'Sociales y Ciudadanas') and made test_classup_backend.py restore user_test123's demo profile in module teardown so the demo data remains pristine after every run. Full suite: 62/62 passing (18 iter-1 + 22 iter-2 + 22 iter-3). Frontend smoke test on https://study-castle.preview.emergentagent.com/ with Bearer TEST_TOKEN_123: Home greets 'Buenos días, Juan David Martínez / Grado 9° · A', 'Entrega próxima' banner shows 'Entregar ensayo · vence en 3 h' (due-soon logic OK), stat cards show PROMEDIO 4.3 / TAREAS 1/26 / ESTUDIO 95 min. Tasks screen lists 25 pendientes with subject color chips (Matemáticas green, Lectura Crítica pink, etc.). Calendar shows dots on 26/27/28/29/30. Grades shows overall 4.3 with per-subject breakdown (Sociales, Matemáticas, Lectura Crítica, Inglés, Ciencias Naturales). Resources filters (Todos/Lectura Crítica/Matemáticas/Sociales/…) render correctly. Profile 'MIS DATOS' shows Sección 9°A, Jornada Tarde, guardian María Martínez, phone 3000000000. Deprecated packages detected: `shadow*` React Native style props are deprecated (migrate to `boxShadow`). No SafeAreaView issues detected. Demo data preserved after all writes.

react_native_issues.issue: Console spams 'shadow*' style props are deprecated. Use 'boxShadow' — appears on every screen render. RN 0.76+ deprecates individual shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowRadius/shadowOpacity. Migrate to unified boxShadow. Reference: various StyleSheet.create({...}) blocks across /app/frontend/app/**

action_items: Migrate all StyleSheet blocks that use shadowColor/shadowOffset/shadowRadius/shadowOpacity to the unified `boxShadow` property (RN 0.76+ deprecation). Affects every screen — console shows the warning repeatedly.
Consider migrating @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') in /app/backend/server.py to FastAPI's lifespan context manager (carry-over from iter 1/2).
Enforce Enum/Literal on `jornada` (Mañana/Tarde/Única) in ProfileSetup and ProfileUpdate to prevent free-text typos (carry-over from iter 2).
Optional hardening: add Pydantic min_length/max_length constraints on name / guardian_name / phones to prevent abuse.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py PATCH /api/profile: `payload.model_dump(exclude_none=True)` strips None but keeps empty strings, so empty-string on a required field is correctly rejected. However pydantic parses an unset key as None (excluded), so `PATCH /api/profile {"section":""}` currently returns 'Campo obligatorio: section' which is the intended behaviour. Confirmed by test.

server.py bulk import: resources upsert uses `url` as the key, which is correct, and the new endpoint does not mutate profile_setup_completed / initial_assessment_completed even if `profile` sub-payload is provided — behaviour confirmed by test.

The 404 console errors on /resources are for external YouTube thumbnail images (mqdefault.jpg not available for some video IDs) — cosmetic, non-blocking. Consider a fallback thumbnail in the Resource component.
